overview: A viral video. A group of friends. And a disappearance that changes everything. Jon disappears after a night of partying on Mt. The only clue: a video recorded hours earlier. Is it a heavy joke or is it a real disappearance? Everyone has reason to hate him... Is he alive or dead?
title: Desagertuta

overview: After suffering a scandal, former star Pei Jia decides to make a fresh start as an actor to remake his image. His co-star turns out to be Su Yi, a total rookie with no acting experience. In order to get on the same wavelength, the two are forced to live together and share a bed. Their relationship starts to turn ambiguous against the pressure of the entertainment industry, as Pei Jia has to fight for not just his work, but also the man he loves.
title: The Sparkle in Your Eye

overview: Tomáš Benkovský arrives at the Department of Violent Crime in Bratislava. His father, a forensic pathologist, has arranged a place for him. Apart from Tomáš, his team includes Oliver, Sergej, Rudo . The psychologist Jana also works in the department. The head of the whole department is Milan. Alongside the investigation of crimes, the lives of Ivan and Tomáš are also revealed. Ivan has a problem with his daughter, and it spills over into his relationship with his wife. Tomáš, in turn, moves into an apartment with his girlfriend - journalist Lucia. Meanwhile, Tomáš has a damaged relationship with his father, whom he meets at work - he blames him for his workaholism and blames him for his mother's accident, which left her in a wheelchair.
title: Mesto tieňov

overview: Raised by his brother Song Li, Song Qi's deep dependence turns into obsessive love. As Song Li seeks a normal life, Song Qi's possessiveness spirals into madness, pushing their bond into a painful battle between love and control
title: Moon and Dust

overview: The EMPIRE OF HOBBYHORSING is the first hobbyhorsing media tournament in the history of mankind. 8 star participants compete in a "ride" on a wooden stick with a horse's head, and professional and star judges decide which of the riders is the best. There are 4 duels waiting for you, the winner of each one goes to the finals, where the world's first Emperor of Hobbyhorsing will be determined.
title: ИМПЕРИЯ ХОББИХОРСИНГА

overview: Ilya Satyr is a new interviewer. But doing interviews based on classics is boring. That's why in this show he calls the guests, makes parodies of them, shows them these parodies in person - and asks for a comment.
title: Я так вижу

overview: Kelsey's Homemade is Kelsey Nixon's new series that explores her life as a small-town girl living in the city, growing her family and reinventing traditions where food and cooking are always at the center of the celebration.
title: Kelsey's Homemade

overview: After her mother's death, Mila becomes her father's support both at home and in business. But the family situation gets tense when her father gets close to the fortune teller Albina. Mila doesn't believe in the sincerity of Albina's feelings and, having quarreled with her father on this basis, decides to start an independent life. She leaves the family business and accidentally meets the charming psychic Sergei, hoping that thanks to his abilities she will expose her stepmother. Having become close to Sergei, Mila realizes that she has fallen in love, although she has a fiancé... Nevertheless, the young people begin to work together and become a real team. And Sergei's gift really helps to shed light on the circumstances of Mila's life and her loved ones.
title: Магия сердца

overview: This is a story about the work of an ordinary traffic police department (the old-fashioned way of saying - GAI) of one of the administrative districts of Moscow. The life of a "traffic cop" is full of events of various natures: dramatic, lyrical, sometimes even tragic, but more often, fortunately, comedic. The series will show the life and work of the traffic police department, through the prism of which the characters, experiences and aspirations of ordinary people, ordinary citizens of Russia working in this "unusual ordinary" profession are refracted. She left her mark on each of them. In someone, she emphasized the best qualities, someone pushed to develop all the worst. The plot is based on the story of the senior duty officer Ogoshkov, who, because of his love for the girl Inga, finds himself drawn into criminal machinations. His fellow traffic cops will have to solve these crimes. The series will have a place for chases, and romantic encounters, and personal dramas, and real men's actions.
title: ГIБДД i т.д
Tou Wo Yanfa Chengguo Hou, Wo Zhenjing ShiJie

overview: Reporting that helps global leaders stay ahead, plus insight on the people, companies and trends.
title: Bloomberg Businessweek Daily

overview: Story about three nice Russian girls, who work at amateur flying club.
title: Русские амазонки

overview: Alix Steel, Romaine Bostick and Scarlet Fu own the market-moving breaking news around the closing bell; a synthesis focusing on the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street.
title: Bloomberg: The Close

overview: The series introduces Amber, one of the world's most brilliant thieves who, after a failed robbery in Las Vegas, prepares her next heist. This time, it will be on Hope Island, a paradise lost in the middle of the Pacific. Her target is the Saint Agatha Tiara, a jewel valued at $240 million, which the daughter of Mexican oil magnate Emilio Villegas will wear at her wedding. To prepare for the robbery, Amber has spent three years undercover as a governess in the Villegas family. But her meticulous plan goes awry when Rui, a brazen and mysterious thief with whom she had a complicated relationship in Las Vegas during a spectacular heist, appears on the island.
title: Ladrones: la tiara de santa Águeda

overview: MotorWeek is an American automotive television series. The program premiered on October 15, 1981 and is hosted by automotive journalist John H. Davis, who is also the series' creator and executive producer. MotorWeek is produced by Maryland Public Television and is seen nationwide on Public Broadcasting Service (PBS),Discovery Network, Velocity, V-me and globally on the American Forces Network. The half-hour program is presented in a magazine-like format, with reviews, comparisons, news, and features. MotorWeek's original slogan was "Television's automotive magazine", later changed to "Television's original automotive magazine", although the BBC's Top Gear debuted in 1977. The show went into national syndication beginning September 11, 1993, originally syndicated by ITC Entertainment.
title: MotorWeek

overview: In a place where lives are at stake every day, there seems to be no room for anything else, let alone the doctors' own lives. But doctors are only human too, and so it often happens that where there is no room for personal failure, such failure must inevitably occur. The daily struggle for life in the emergency room, and whether God is watching over the patient or everything is solely in the hands of the doctors, brings many traumas, eternal questions and dilemmas to the doctors themselves. Two young doctors arrive at the central reception, still carrying their ideals and ideas from the faculty. These disappear with a flick of a wand when they enter a real hospital, where they are both attested. Agáta and Braňo also have a shared past, which did not go well at school, and so a natural medical rivalry develops between them. Superficiality, superiority, heart, compassion and solidarity are the themes that the doctors deal with day in and day out, and each of them brings their own spin to the job. Every day there is something new to learn, and often the protagonists come to understand that they are not gods. That's probably the hardest lesson of all for the two young doctors who have just arrived and think they can save the world to learn. The doctors at the hospital live their jobs to the fullest, and so have little room to get to know their life partners outside the hospital. Hence, workplace relationships often develop and there is a drawing in of life's vicissitudes and relationship problems right into the ward.
title: Nemocnica

overview: Four fathers were brought together in a kindergarten attended by their offspring. Alex, a lawyer, Marek, a divorcee, Vlado, a pizzeria owner, and Tomáš, a widower, are trying to cope with their lives and their roles as fathers and partners.
title: Oteckovia

overview: Vyprávěj is a Czech television retroseries. The story takes place in Czechoslovakia (later Czech Republic) and is set in real historical events that influence the stories of the individual characters. The authors evoke the atmosphere of the time with excerpts from contemporary Czechoslovak newsreels with original commentaries, or a new historicizing commentary by Vladimír Fišer, or period music. The story is accompanied by the voice of the narrator, which was lent to the project by actor Vojtěch Kotek and then Matěj Hádek. The series was a great success, one of the most successful projects of Czech Television and is regularly repeated.
title: Vyprávěj

overview: He fooled everyone – the banks, the millionaires and the police, stole identities, kidnapped and robbed. This is the story of Norway's most cunning fraudster.
title: Fantomet Philip

overview: The main characters are only fifteen or sixteen years old at the beginning, having left primary school and starting high school. They are no longer children and they are ready to jump straight into everything. They are going through a period of rebellion against parents and teachers, a period of searching and disappointment, first fateful loves, friendships and enmities. Different types of people meet in the classroom. They have different interests, attitudes, family backgrounds, dreams and different ideas about how to spend their free time. Some are skateboarders, others are nerds, some live for music, others for computers. There are athletes and intellectuals among them. Some are sociable, others are withdrawn. Chatting, computer games and virtual reality are more important to some than real friendship.
title: 4teens

overview: Hella von Sinnen, Wigald Boning and the panel guests humorously try to find answers to open questions.
title: Genial daneben

overview: An elite brothel for VIPs. Here, hot caresses are sold and serious passions boil. A well-oiled criminal mechanism has failed: one of the new girls is killed. In order not to jeopardize her well-being, the middle-aged manager of the brothel decides to cover up the matter as quickly as possible. To do this, she calls the head of security - a cynical, ruthless thug nicknamed Cain - and orders him to eliminate the girl's mother... The cruel laws of the big city, the delights of criminal love, the weaknesses of the powerful. What is life "on the other side" of morality - and what is it, the code of dishonor?
title: Проклятый рай

overview: They are called "Flying Squad". They report directly to the Economic Counterintelligence Directorate. They are the best people in their profession! The glorious five: the head of the group - Lieutenant Colonel Kirsanov, Senior Lieutenant Grushin, Major Artemyev, the beautiful investigator Kalugina and Captain Tarasyuk. "Flying Squad" is entrusted with a task of special importance: to ensure the security of the state border, catch criminals and punish werewolves in uniform.
title: Летучий отряд

overview: Animal Magic was a BBC children's television series which ran from 1962 to 1983 from BBC Bristol. It began fortnightly and was transmitted weekly from 1964. The presenter was the avuncular Johnny Morris. Morris' co-presenters over the years were: Gerald Durrell, Tony Soper, Keith Shackleton, Roger Tabor, Sheila Young, David Taylor and Terry Nutkins. When Nutkins joined the show in the early 1980s, the producers tried to update it, using new video effects technology. This allowed them to do such things as "shrink" the presenters to allow them to see life from an ant's viewpoint, or to swim in a riverbed for example. Dottie the ring-tailed lemur appeared as a regular guest for eight years in the 1970s. Much to Morris' anger, the show was discontinued in 1983 when the programme's anthropomorphic treatment of animals fell out of fashion. The 100th edition was transmitted on 4 January 1967.
title: Animal Magic

overview: Four directors, twenty gripping stories, a kaleidoscope of genres from thriller to comedy. Each episode is an hour of real time that the viewer will live together with the characters of the series. An hour that will become a turning point in the characters' destinies, an hour after which nothing will be the same as before... The format of "The Last Minute" is unusual: there are no through characters, no single story. The episodes are separate short stories, the plots of which develop in real time. The characters live ordinary lives, they have their own concerns, affairs, work, family and secrets. But life can make a sharp turn in an instant, and then everything turns upside down. The secret becomes clear, friends - enemies, chance encounters - fatal... How will the characters of the series act? How will it all end? Who will be the winner, and who will have to part with life? Everything will become clear only at the last minute...
title: Последняя минута

overview: They begin, develop and end in an hour. In one place and with no more than four characters. High suspense, great police tone, humor, unexpected twists, the viewer does not guess the outcome until the end.
title: Tiempofinal

overview: Several Thriller Stories in Spain.
title: Desenlace

overview: A series exploring the final hours of individuals' lives, each episode confined to a single location with no more than three or four characters.
title: Tiempo final

overview: Six unrelated stories of crimes of passion, with a lot of suspense .
title: Tempo Final

overview: The series tells the story of the multi-generational Lubicz family, whose seniors are Maria and Wladyslaw Lubicz. Maria was the owner of the family pharmacy "Pod Modrzewiem", and Wladyslaw was a juvenile court superintendent. During their more than 50 years of married life, they had five children - Elizabeth, Pawel, Monica, Dorothy and Richard - followed by a bunch of grandchildren and several great-grandchildren. Despite adversity and the surprises it cooks up for them, the inevitable conflicts, for the Lubiczes family always comes first. The siblings support each other and can always count on each other in difficult moments. The series depicts the realities of everyday life and raises important social issues.
title: Klan

overview: Maria Della Luce Távora Gonzaga Valenti, Duchess of Orvieto, fed up with being chased by the paparazzi, leaves Italy, where she lived with part of her family. Portugal, more specifically Arcos de Valdevez and Peneda, are the refuge chosen by the young woman, who will go by the name of Luz.
title: Deixa Que Te Leve

overview: The young Maria Corleone has moved from Palermo, Sicily to Milan and is realizing her dream of becoming a stylist; she has a partner, Luca Spada, a young prosecutor with whom she is expecting a child. Having returned to Sicily for the big party for her parents' wedding anniversary, she is involved in an attack that will change her life forever. Little by little Maria will enter the criminal mechanisms of the mafia, coming to terms with her conscience to defend the life and honor of the Corleones: but this will weigh dramatically on her relationship with Luca and their child.
title: Maria Corleone

overview: Follows Michael Henry and Tim Murray, two comedians who for the first time perform standup on the road in North America.
title: Wish You Were Queer

overview: I'm a Celebrity, Get Me Out of Here! is the country's top survival reality TV show, where celebrities must live without any comforts and compete against each other in order to be crowned winner.
title: I'm a Celebrity, Get Me Out of Here!

overview: Blockbusters is a game show in which contestants answer trivia questions to complete a path across or down a game board of hexagons.
title: Blockbusters

overview: Segodnya (Russian: Сего́дня) is a news program broadcast by Russian broadcaster NTV. It first began airing on October 10, 1993, the day NTV was founded, and continues to air to this day.
title: Сегодня

overview: The format is based on real stories of ordinary people who have to deal with major life situations. Families are different and life within them is different. Even with the best efforts, parents' child-rearing sometimes gets out of hand and disaster strikes. Other times, they just get mixed up in the wrong crowd and suddenly the whole family has a hell of a life! This is exactly the kind of situation that the new format called Rodinné prípady deals with.
title: Rodinné prípady

overview: The series focuses on Daniel Ludsky, a forensic expert and expert diagnostician.
title: Dr. Dokonalý

overview: The original JOJ TV series presents medical stories in a completely different way than before.The fictional stories about medical errors or failures are in many cases inspired by real events.Tomáš Maštalír as MUDr. Daniel Ludsky is an expert on diagnoses and medical malpractice. As a forensic expert, he often cooperates with the police. Dr. Ludsky is not the hero we are used to - he is intelligent, uncompromising, arrogant and impatient. He hates sloppiness and incompetence, so he doesn't have many friends among his colleagues. But he believes in the truth and in the patient's right to be treated decently. He is not very happy in private either. He is divorced and, alongside his work, struggles to find time for his teenage daughter.
title: Dr. Ludsky

overview: In a mining village shrouded in a dark and sinister past, an entire family is found brutally murdered. Has an angry spirit returned to seek revenge? Has the long-dormant curse been reawakened? Who—or what—is responsible for the hundreds of bodies unearthed during the investigation? Inspector Veer Pratap Singh, who has just arrived in the village to take charge, is thrust into a chilling investigation that will test his resolve and alter the course of his life forever.
title: Khadaan

overview: The drama tells the love story of a playboy and a nurse student in a comedy style.
title: Infidelity it's a disease

overview: When Rachel Nickell is stabbed to death on Wimbledon Common in 1992 the police launch the biggest investigation since the Yorkshire Ripper. Colin Stagg is arrested, only for the judge to throw out the case.
title: The Wimbledon Killer

overview: She's not just the little sister of Marcus and Martinus, because Emma is following her own dream of becoming an artist.
title: Emma

overview: Home Made Simple is a lifestyle brand that features tips, advice and ideas for the home primarily on its website, TV show and through email. It is supported by the Procter & Gamble brands: Cascade, Dawn, Febreze, Gain Ultra, Mr. Clean, and Swiffer. Home Made Simple is what marketers call a cohort site, a website that promotes a product or multiple products by providing helpful information, like recipes and tips, not solely advertising and marketing messages. In the summer of 2006, the Home Made Simple TV show debuted on the US cable network TLC. The show was produced by Rob Mancini. It is a weekly home improvement reality show based on the Home Made Simple website. The hosts of the show through Season 8 were Home Maven: Patrick Brown, Decor Maven: Wanda Colon and Cooking Maven: Jamika Pessoa. The featured guest of each week's show were nominated by their friends or family on the Home Made Simple website. Friends help the featured guest with projects in their home with guidance from the hosts. Common projects on the show are easy meals, minor fix-its, room organization and interior decorating. The Home Mavens share expert tips in each episode. Products from Mr. Clean, Febreze, Dawn, Cascade and Swiffer, the sponsoring brands, are used throughout the show. The show moved to Oprah Winfrey Network at the start of Season 9. Although OWN would classify this as Season 1 on their network. It debuted on October 23, 2011, and featured two major changes: it was hosted by Paige Davis (former host of Trading Spaces), and 2) The mavens have been replaced with a panel of experts. The new experts include: cooking experts Jesse Brune, Ronnie Woo, Martita Jara, and Ceci Carmichael; design expert Kristan Cunningham; design, planning and cooking expert Tracy Metro; design and carpentry expert Brooks Utley; and architecture expert Kenneth Wingard. The third season will be shortened to a half-an-hour time slot, with new host Soleil Moon Frye, with an October 2013 premiere
title: Home Made Simple

overview: Criminal investigator Li Yujing is temporarily assigned to assist female officer Yue Qingchuan in solving a series of child trafficking cases. During the investigation, he unexpectedly uncovers a lead connected to an armed robbery case he handled 13 years ago. Together, the two cross a 13-year gap, unfolding a hard-boiled manhunt across dual timelines.
title: Cold Hunt

overview: Zhan Peng's father was a railway policeman who was posthumously honored as a martyr for his sacrifice many years ago. Influenced by that, Zhan Peng had always aspired to follow in his father's footsteps and serve in the very same station where his father once worked. However, when he finally arrived in Xiaotong and began his duties, he discovered that the situation there was far more complex than he had imagined. Upon first meeting Tu Hongjiang, he did not trust this veteran police officer. Tu Hongjiang's suspicious behaviors during the handling of a drug trafficking case even made Zhan Peng wary of him. However, as time passed, Tu Hongjiang proved his innocence through his actions. As they worked together on cases, Zhan Peng gradually developed respect for Tu Hongjiang, and the two eventually joined forces to apprehend the mastermind behind the crimes
title: Double Track Puzzle

overview: At the end of the Eastern Han Dynasty, General Dou Wu was defeated in his fight against the eunuchs' dictatorship, leading to the execution of his entire family. His eight-year-old daughter Dou Ling escaped and vowed revenge. Taking on the alias "Yanhuang", she infiltrated the Caiyi Workshop, an assassin organization controlled by the enemies. Navigating a vortex of slaughter and conspiracy, she bode her time to get closer to her targets, Zhang Huan and Cao Jie, and rose through the ranks with her exceptional wit and martial arts. But as she finally approached Cao Jie, her true identity was at risk of being exposed...
title: Vow of the Phoenix

overview: LIFTOFF is an adventure series following world-class big wave surfer Niccolo Porcella, and one of the world's best wingsuit pilots, Jokke Sommer, as they attempt to switch sports. The series takes them on a global mission to Hawaii, Dubai, France, Italy, Switzerland, and Norway, assisted by legendary mentors in each other's sports.
title: Liftoff

overview: The host of the program, Alexander Ingilevich, goes on expeditions to find real prototypes of the heroes of legends, myths and fairy tales. Deep dive into different historical eras, elements of feature films, amazing finds and sensational discoveries. Легенды и мифы will prove that much of what is considered fiction actually happened!
title: Легенды и мифы

overview: These crimes were not written about in the newspapers, not talked about on the radio. Thousands of criminal cases are still classified as "secret". But it is time to penetrate the closed archives. Masterful swindlers, elusive thieves and even serial killers - they also existed in the Soviet era. But there were also those who entered into an "invisible battle" with them. How did detectives work without mobile phones, computers and the most complex examinations? And what criminal secrets were ordered to be forgotten?
title: Легенды советского сыска

overview: The incredible story of a young woman who ripped up the rulebook and reinvented the novel. Famous faces celebrate her remarkable life and beloved stories that still resonate today.
title: Jane Austen: Rise of a Genius

overview: Acclaimed music artists from Aotearoa share their deeply personal stories of disconnection, reclamation, vulnerability, and courage when they translate and record songs in te reo Māori.
title: Waiata Anthems

overview: After retiring from gymnastics, Han Jiwon thought his biggest challenges were behind him. Turns out, winning Olympic medals was easy compared to surviving university as a painfully shy ex-superstar. Enter Kwon Jungwoo—campus heartthrob, basketball star, and a whole new world of trouble wrapped up in a perfect smile. But just when Jiwon thinks he has Jungwoo figured out, he discovers a surprisingly sweet side beneath that cold exterior. Can this unlikely duo overcome their differences and stick the landing on their budding romance?
title: Ball Boy Tactics

overview: When the imperial concubine dies mysteriously among peach blossoms during her visit to Peach Blossom Manor, wandering swordsman Yan Shiyi becomes the prime suspect. Cold Blade, her appointed bodyguard, seals the estate, forbidding anyone to leave. As the inquiry deepens, the manor's hidden sins surface, and the truth grows ever more elusive…
title: Blades Amid Blossoms

overview: Formula DRIFT's popular web-based program, Formula Drift Insider returns this Sunday, August 3 at 10:30 AM (PST) / 1:30 PM (EST). The years show will provide a behind the scenes companion to the live-to-tape NBC Sports Network program. Formula DRIFT Insider will travel with the drivers to their homes, on the road and give an exclusive look from the driver's point of view of what goes on during the live competition.
title: Formula Drift Insider

overview: A master assassin, Cheng Ge, disguises himself as a humble robe attendant to Emperor Shi Yu to carry out his deadliest mission. But as he becomes entangled in the lethal power struggles of the court and its buried secrets from the past, his simple plan unravels. Now, the hunter trapped in his own game must make the ultimate choice: to strike or to protect?
title: In The Name of Loyalty

overview: Prince Xiao Xian sends men to search for his lover Lin Hong'er, whom he met by chance among the common people. Xu Ziyi, who looks strikingly like Lin Hong'er, takes her place. To keep the secret, the Xu family murders Lin Hong'er's family, leaving her disfigured. After being rescued by the enigmatic wandering doctor Shentu Yu, Lin Hong'er changes her appearance and adopts the alias Hong Linlang, embarking on a path of vengeance.
title: The Queen of Attack

overview: Fan Dayao is the notorious Tiger Demon King of Qianchun Mountain, immensely powerful and utterly domineering. Shen Wangchen, the son of the City Lord of Moyuan, was born frail and aloof, keeping his distance from others. Upon reaching adulthood, Shen embarks on a journey to seek out a cat demon in hopes of curing his illness. When the two cross paths, an absurd yet amusing "human - demon cohabitation" begins...
title: The Demon

overview: After dying in a car crash caused by her cheating boyfriend, Jin Xiaowan is reborn in 1999 - as a five-year-old prodigy! Using her modern-day knowledge, she helps her mother, Lin Han, dump toxic men, build a fortune, and even sparks a romance with the wealthy Ying Huiming. But when Xiaowan realizes her mom might also be a reborn soul, their heartwarming mother-daughter duo teams up to rewrite destiny - only to discover Mom has her own secret plans...
title: Threading Mom's Wings

overview: Feng Zuoren, commander of the Snow Feather Guards, infiltrates the Marquis' estate under imperial orders to find and eliminate the former crown prince. Her mission becomes complicated when she crosses paths with the young lord, Xue Hexu. Their initial deadly encounters slowly transform into a complex bond, blossoming into an unexpected affection amidst the domestic intrigue and power struggles! However, they soon discover that a far greater conspiracy is unfolding behind the scenes, masterminded by a hidden puppeteer.
title: Moonlit Order

overview: Jiang Leyao, a girl from a humble background, marries into a powerful family, only to be betrayed and brutally tormented by her closest friend and a group of the wealthy and powerful. Her life ends in tragedy until she wakes up back in time. Yet her so-called best friend has also been reborn… And this time, she's stolen Jiang Leyao's place as the bride of high society. But Leyao isn't the only one with secrets. Behind her friend stands a shadowy figure of great power who's been pulling the strings…
title: She Is the Phoenix

overview: Lu Anning and Ling Cang, bound by a thousand lifetimes of tragic love, are puppets of destiny, from fierce rivals to awakening souls. They join forces in divine cultivation, fighting to break free from fate's cruel game.
title: Above the Clouds

overview: "There are few places in the world where life and death decisions are made. Women know them intimately; men tiptoe around them." The series Ordinacja v rosovej zahrada reveals the thirteenth chamber of medicine, more precisely the gynaecological and obstetric ward of a hospital in an unnamed Slovak town and a private gynaecological clinic.These environments are linked not only by a common mission, but also by the collegial and friendly relations of the main characters. The protagonists are not only the doctors and nurses, but also their family members, partners, friends and especially the patients. The protagonists of the series emphasize the psychology of the characters in authentic contemporary "life". The series gives the opportunity for interesting acting performances and the viewer has the opportunity to get to know Slovak actors, well-known faces in the media, who return from the position of presenters and entertainers back to what they do so well on the stage. The series Ordinacja v rozove zahrada (Ordination in the Rose Garden) has been a huge success in the neighbouring Czech Republic, where it has become a long-running series with high ratings.
title: Ordinácia v ružovej záhrade

overview: Dotyk života is a television series from a medical background in which midwives help bring new lives into the world... Childbirth is one of the few experiences that brings us all together, and the setting is usually a maternity ward, whose staff experience both conflict and the most beautiful joys during the busy days and nights. Outwardly, they are all part of a good-hearted and cohesive team, but sometimes they are subject to enormous mental and physical strain. Like the head midwife, Eva, who is surrounded by new life every day and secretly longs for children of her own, but finds it difficult to forge close relationships. She, her colleagues, and all incoming mothers share this place, a place of fear, uncertainty and guilt, but also a place of trust, laughter, love and the greatest bliss of all, which is the touch of new life.
title: Dotyk života

overview: A terrifying plague of rotting corpses sweeps through Xuan City. The occultist Dong Qing emerges to confront the crisis. Before him stand the imposing, righteous City Lord Nan Feng and his gentle, courteous eldest son, Nan Zhengci. Yet, Dong Qing senses something deeply amiss. Is this grotesque epidemic a heavenly punishment or a man-made calamity? He resolves to pierce the veil of doubt and uncover the truth!
title: Zombie Warfare

overview: Nosler's Live2Hunt with Cody & Kelsy (previously known as Live 2 Hunt with Cody Robbins) chronicles Cody's quest to combine the biggest free-range, fair chase animals; hard-core, never-say-die hunting attitude; and a humble, everyman approach that makes you feel like you're having a once-in-a-lifetime hunt with your best hunting buddy. Cody's the guy who became Jim Shockey's first official cameraman and TV producer. For years he was Jim's right-hand man, traveling and hunting with the legend in more than 15 countries. Now Cody steps from Jim's shadow to blaze his own trail in professional hunting television!
title: Live2Hunt with Cody Robbins

overview: What sparks the viewer's imagination more than the question of what the In aller Freundschaft family does when night falls at the Sachsenklinik, the lights go out and the real work is done? In this web series, you can experience a rather unusual side of the Freundschaft stars outside of their everyday hospital life. The Sachsenklinik is anything but black and white at night. The new night porter at the Sachsenklinik, Tom Fichte, who actually hopes to have enough time to watch the broadcasts of his favorite soccer club and, to his horror, barely makes it to the toilet in peace and quiet, learns this too.
title: In aller Freundschaft - Nachts in der Sachsenklinik

overview: After losing her family and being cast aside by her wealthy husband Qian Muchen, Bai Luo returns from the depths of despair with a new identity—a songstress at the Paramount Club. Behind the glamour, she plots her revenge with chilling precision. This time, she'll make everyone dance in the palm of her hand.
title: Paramount

overview: Celebrities answer very difficult questions about everyday things and problems.
title: Wer weiß denn sowas?

overview: Gefragt – Gejagt ("Asked - Hunted") is the German adaptation of the British show The Chase. In this beloved show, a team of four candidates competes against a superbrain, the "Hunter". That's not an easy task, as the hunters are proven quiz professionals.
title: Gefragt – Gejagt

overview: Télématin is a French television program broadcast on Antenne 2 and then France 2 since January 10, 1985. This morning program offers news and features on culture and daily life. Its concept is based on the American Today program.
title: Télématin

overview: Sixteen celebrities attempt a spectacular prison break. Their goal: to remain free for five days while three hunters are hot on their heels. While the hunters are supported by regular GPS data, the targets, who have no money or cell phones, rely on the help of the public. But beware: any citizen could become an informant for their pursuers.
title: Most Wanted – Wer entkommt?

overview: Кой да знае? is the Bulgarian version of the German TV show Wer weiß denn sowas?. It is a weekday comedy quiz show that airs in primetime on bTV, hosted by Aleksandar Kadiev.
title: Кой да знае?

overview: The ZDF-Fernsehgarten is a entertainment show that is broadcast live from the ZDF broadcasting center in Mainz-Lerchenberg on Sunday mornings from May to September. Around 20 programs are produced each year.
title: ZDF-Fernsehgarten

overview: Daily mental gymnastics to have fun with the French language and enrich your general knowledge.
title: Tout le monde a son mot à dire

overview: SWAROVSKI OPTIK Quests travels the globe, with corporate partners that include RAM, Safari Club International and HS Precision rifles. SWAROVSKI OPTIK North America Director of Communication, Dean Capuano, along with Lance Kronberger of Freelance Outdoor Adventures, will hunt out of a remote spike camp far off the grid. Getting there is an adventure in itself and once they get on-site, Dean will have to conquer the terrain and the weather before getting close to one of the largest land carnivores on earth. Each action packed episode features a team of SWAROVSKI OPTIK Pro-Staffers traveling to the world's most exotic locations in search of the planets most difficult and sought-after trophies while showcasing SWAROVSKI OPTIK's high precision, high quality, sought-after optics. SWAROVSKI OPTIK is at the top of every hunter and outdoorsman's dream list. All over the world, enthusiastic hunters place their trust in the long tradition and uncompromising excellence of the high-quality long-range optics.
title: SWAROVSKI OPTIK Quests

overview: Two schoolboys who have just discovered a mutual attraction are witnesses to the murder of three gang members. In a mix of fear and embarrassment, the teenagers hope that staying silent will keep them alive.
title: Die Augenzeugen

overview: In this Prince Charming spin-off, former contestants from the dating show and new participants go on a flirtation course. Against a picturesque backdrop, they go on breathtaking dates in search of Mr. Right.
title: Charming Boys

overview: La Piste de Xapatan was a game show broadcast on Antenne 2 from February 21, 1992 to July 3, 1992, created by Jacques Antoine and presented by Sophie Davant and Grégory Frank.
title: La Piste de Xapatan

overview: Two men, Jugal and Romil, fall in love with each other but are scared that their orthodox family would not accept them. However, they decide to overcome all their obstacles together.
title: Romil & Jugal

overview: They met immediately after World War II, a man and a woman who lost everything, and despite the traumas they endured they fell in love. 25 years later, Uri and Anna are still in love. But when the Mossad recruits Uri for a dangerous mission in Germany, memories start to return, cracks begin to appear in their perfect relationship, and a terrible suspicion grows in Anna.
title: The German

overview: Heir to the Madelin throne Princess Blue pays a visit to Thailand where she meets Wayo Wathinwanit, a police officer assigned to look after her safety. However, their trip turns into a nightmare when an assassination attempt forces the princess to flee, and Lom is the only one who can protect her. While hiding from the enemy, the two face danger and situations of defiance, leading them to an intimacy and forbidden feelings that may not be stopped. Though knowing well that this time, love may be impossible, Lom's heart demands that she protects the princess at all costs. When the enemy discover their hiding place, a final battle is about to take place.
title: 4 Elements: The Air

overview: This promises viewers an unforgettable journey into the depths of human existence, while Dastmalchian guides his guests through discussions that delve into personal reflections on mortality, legacy, and the afterlife.
title: Grave Conversations
